title: Halliburton launches Volta™ all-electric control system to advance intelligent completions
summary: Volta all-electric control system allows customers to execute continuous health and reservoir monitoring and gain critical insights to improve well performance.
body_markdown:
#### Volta™ all-electric control system


Volta delivers intelligent completions, zonal control, and real-time reservoir management for optimized well performance


[Explore](https://www.halliburton.com/en/products/volta-all-electric-control-system.html)


#### SmartWell® intelligent completion systems


Collect, transmit, and analyze downhole data, and remotely control and monitor reservoir zones with Halliburton SmartWell® completion systems.


[Explore](https://www.halliburton.com/en/completions/well-completions/intelligent-completions/smartwell-technology-enhanced-functionality.html)


#### Clariti® flow and manage software


Real-time optimization for SmartWell® intelligent completion systems


[Explore](https://www.halliburton.com/en/products/clariti-flow-and-manage-software.html)


#### EcoStar® electric tubing-retrievable safety valve


World’s first electric tubing-retrievable safety valve, enabling a fully electric completion system with zero risk of exposing electronics to wellbore fluid.


[Explore](https://www.halliburton.com/en/products/ecostar-tubing-retrievable-safety-valve.html)


#### Intelligent completions


Halliburton intelligent completions technology help accelerate production and improve decision-making to increase ultimate recovery and maximize asset value


[Explore](https://www.halliburton.com/en/completions/well-completions/intelligent-completions.html)
